about.title: About Ask Algeria
about.lead: One front door to Algerian public-service information. You ask in your own words; we find the official page that answers it.

sections.title: How it works
body: We regularly read official Algerian government websites, mostly .gov.dz and .dz domains, including the PDF guides and forms they publish.
When you ask a question, the system searches that collection in French, Arabic and English and picks the most relevant passages.
An AI model writes the answer using only those passages. Every fact links to the page it came from.
If the official pages we have don't cover your question, the answer says so and points you to the most relevant official site.

sections.title: This is not a government website
body: Ask Algeria is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by the Government of Algeria or any ministry, wilaya or public body.
We can't submit applications, book appointments or look up your personal records.
We don't give legal, tax, medical or financial advice.
Procedures, fees and deadlines change. Always confirm on the official page before you act.

sections.title: Your privacy
body: ID numbers, phone numbers, emails and bank or card numbers are removed in your browser before your question is sent.
We don't keep a history of your conversations.
Documents you upload are processed only to produce your result and are not stored.

sections.title: Neutrality
body: Answers describe official procedures only. We don't take positions on parties, candidates or political questions. For elections, we only explain how to register and vote according to official sources.
